status: PROPOSED — specifications, not evidence. Oracles frozen before any evaluator exists.

outcome_semantics.ADMIT: claim is eligible for a witnessed admission; the reducer may transition state
outcome_semantics.HOLD: claim is neither falsified nor earned; no transition; stays on the frontier
outcome_semantics.REJECT: claim is falsified or structurally inadmissible as stated; no transition
outcome_semantics.NO_TRANSITION: no governed transition is in question; HELEN stays out

KEEP.text: Observation does not entail Cause (O ⇏ I ⇏ C). Silent derivation of the latter from the former is forbidden.
Generation does not grant Authority. A proposal cannot self-authorize when the transition is consequential and uncertain.
No valid witnessed Admission ⇒ no State transition. ΔX = 0.

REVISE.now: Remove(M) ∧ Preserve(E) ⇒ M is not established as necessary for E (another sufficient mechanism may exist).
VerificationValue = f(Independence, Reliability, Coverage). Heterogeneity is necessary for independence, not sufficient for value.
Conditional: ConsequentialUncertainTransition ⇒ proposal cannot self-authorize. Trivial deterministic cases are out of scope.
Cognition may loop (O↔T↔J↔W). Only the sovereign boundary is linear: Candidate → ValidAdmission → Reducer → State.
Color is a projection of a typed receipt, never its source. Color(S) ⇏ S.

fixtures.name: valid observation, invalid causal inference

given.observation: EGR fell 40% in week 41; scheduler cadence was changed in week 40.

fixtures.claim_under_test: The scheduler change caused the EGR drop.

expected.reason: Temporal succession is recorded as 🟦 observation. The causal claim has no counterfactual and no sham; it is neither falsified nor earned.

fixtures.isolates: O ⇏ C with the observation itself fully valid.

fixtures.name: strong model consensus, no independent witness

expected.reason: Agreement among same-type verifiers is repetition, not corroboration. Consensus is not a falsification, so REJECT is wrong; it is not a witness, so ADMIT is wrong.

fixtures.isolates: Count of verifiers vs independence of verifiers.

fixtures.name: mechanism removed, effect preserved

given.sham: N1 → coating applied → N1 (blur perceived, identical rendering)

fixtures.claim_under_test: The coating causes the perceived blur.

expected.reason: Mechanism not established as necessary. Not falsified either: a second sufficient mechanism may exist (R1).

fixtures.isolates: The revised law: removal + preservation ⇒ not-necessary, not ⇒ false.

fixtures.name: corrected claim with lineage

expected.reason: Witnessed admission with lineage; C1 remains readable as historical state.
Erasure of C1 and missing lineage make the transition structurally inadmissible even with a valid witness.

fixtures.isolates: Lineage as a precondition of admission, independent of evidence quality.

fixtures.name: redundant witness vs heterogeneous witness

expected.reason: Independence = 0 regardless of reliability and count.
One witness with a different failure mode, high reliability, full coverage.
Heterogeneous but weak: low reliability and partial coverage. JESTER's counter-case to the old law.

fixtures.isolates: f(Independence, Reliability, Coverage) — each variant zeroes one factor.

fixtures.name: MANUCURIST request that already exists

given.request: A tool to visualise the colour on my skin tone.

expected.reason: Requested ≠ Missing ≠ New. The request is kept as 🟦; the diagnosis (DISCOVERABILITY_GAP / FIT_GAP / FULFILLED_DEMAND) is a separate HOLD pending requirement fit.

fixtures.isolates: Rejecting the NEW label without discarding the signal.

fixtures.name: DIRECTOR causal sham
fixtures.claim_under_test: The film establishes the causal grammar: viewers recover the operator.

expected.reason: Identity and state change recovered; operator not recovered (0.41). ArtifactPass ⇏ GrammarEstablished; TemporalChange ≠ RecoverableCause.

fixtures.isolates: A passing artifact with a failing causal component.

fixtures.name: trivial deterministic case where HELEN should stay out

expected.reason: No consequential governed state is in question. Running T→J→W→A here would be waste, not rigour.

fixtures.name: survivor without search history
fixtures.claim_under_test: Report A's three survivors have the same epistemic status as Report B's.

expected.reason: Same survivors, different provenance. SearchHistory ⊂ EpistemicProvenance; A is incomplete. Failure records are provenance, not automatically evidence for the survivor.

fixtures.isolates: Survivorship bias as a structural defect of the receipt, not of the claim.
